vulnerability_title: [M-07] Partial Fills before `amendOrder` TX exposes Users to unintended Risks

recommendation.recommendation_text:
Before applying an amendment in the size of the order, we need to know that the order’s filled amount has not changed since tx submission, this way we can protect user against unwanted trades.

[View detailed Proof of Concept](https://code4rena.com/audits/2025-08-gte-perps-and-launchpad/submissions/F-160)
